1- Rolling the dice and getting the number "6" allows the plane to move and at the same time you can roll the dice again.

5- When you hit the other player's plane, you can roll the dice again.
6- When you roll the dice and get the number "6" three times, your turn will end at that moment, and the other player's turn will begin.
7- The starting point and the places marked with the stars logo are safe zones.
